newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures market closed for holiday.

text.p: The SIMEX Nikkei futures market was closed for a Japanese holiday on Monday. Trading will resume on Tuesday.
On Friday, the benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract ended at 20,630 against a previous settlement at 20,540.
Dealers said there was strong bargain hunting interest below the 20,500 level and the market's relatively firm close pointed to some stability for the near term.
"I think we've seen the short-term bottom already and we may see it trend a little higher next week on technical factors, if nothing else," said a trader with a U.S. institution.
